steps.comment: Entra SSO without FAS - AAA part: OIDC to the Entra Client application, nFactor, authentication profile
steps.note: netscaler-nitro >= v1.2.0: Deploy-NsObjects.ps1 -ConfigFile ./netscaler/10-entra-sso-aaa.json. Prerequisites: features SSL, SSLVPN, AAA, REWRITE enabled; DNS resolver for login.microsoftonline.com (netscaler-nitro examples/00-prereq.json). The Entra Client application comes from scripts/New-EntraSsoClientApp.ps1 -NewSecret; its secret is only in $env:OIDC_ENTRASSO_CLIENT_SECRET (config entraApp.secretEnvVar) of THAT PowerShell session - deploy from the same session. Replace <tenant-id> / <client-app-id> with config tenantId / clientAppId.

steps.comment: OAuth action: Entra OIDC with explicit endpoints
steps.note: NO metadataurl and NO userinfourl: with metadataurl the action takes the Graph userinfo endpoint, which has no oid, and the user name falls back to the UPN. usernamefield MUST be oid: StoreFront Entra SSO rejects a UPN ('... is not an Entra OID (GUID format)'). RS256 only. The same app is the Citrix Client application (Broker AzureSSOnClientId).

steps.comment: Policy label with the OIDC policy (the Entra factor)
Factor 1: no user name, only routes to the Entra factor (NO_AUTHN)
steps.note: Rule true without mTLS. 12-entra-sso-mtls.json changes this rule to CLIENT.SSL.CLIENT_CERT.EXISTS. Factor 1 must never set a user name (no certAction): nFactor keeps the first user name, and StoreFront then gets a UPN instead of the Entra oid and refuses SSO.
No authenticationhost: login and /oauth/login run on the Gateway vserver (11-entra-sso-gateway.json). The Gateway certificate is bound to this vserver in 11.
